## Design

### 2026-10-13 – Brainstormed some ideas for pen accessories, came up with an idea that you can have modules that can screw into the top part of a pen. The current one that I am making is a small screwdriver head from

**2h**

Brainstormed some ideas for pen accessories, came up with an idea that you can have modules that can screw into the top part of a pen. The current one that I am making is a small screwdriver head from a kit. The tool fits inside the enclosure and you are able to screw the top and bottom parts of the screw in to the 'pen'.

I also played around with a lot of features such as filleting and lofting (was unsuccessful).

### 2026-10-13 – I fixed the dimensions for the previous part that held the tool. This was because I accidentally entered the diameter as the radius and it was a pen that was 2 inch thick lol. I added the physical pen

**2h**

I fixed the dimensions for the previous part that held the tool. This was because I accidentally entered the diameter as the radius and it was a pen that was 2 inch thick lol. I added the physical pen and also the tip of the pen. I learned how to use offset planes to create multi-section lofts on the pen tip.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/eeaa45fc70c3fdb963c3a2fe68dee401bfe426af42daec9f0c3cdf50dd89b8a7.png)

### 2026-10-14 – I fixed some of the dimensions and played around with the shapes for the nose of the pen. I learned how to assemble the parts but I still need to figure out how to constrain each part to each other in

**1.5h**

I fixed some of the dimensions and played around with the shapes for the nose of the pen. I learned how to assemble the parts but I still need to figure out how to constrain each part to each other instead of just connecting them in a fixed position. I also CADed the part for the pen cap. After assembling it, i realized that I need to fix some of the dimensions and also fillet some more edges to make it look nicer. I will probably also change the material properties so it doesn't look so plain.

### 2026-10-14 – I learned how to add grooves to the pen tip and also improved the appearance of the pen. I also learned how to animate stuff inside of fusion360 for an exploded view, which is pretty sick to see. This

**1.5h**

I learned how to add grooves to the pen tip and also improved the appearance of the pen. I also learned how to animate stuff inside of fusion360 for an exploded view, which is pretty sick to see. This ultimately took a while because I was trying to figure out how the camera system works. But I'm pretty happy how it turned out in the end.
